commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Nicolas Valentini (Verona) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Maurizio Mariani saw the whole situation. That's a free kick to Bologna.
90+4' The ball goes wide of the goal and out for a goal kick. It looks like Federico Ravaglia (Bologna) is going to take it.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Substitution. Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Riccardo Orsolini walks off.
88' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Verona.
86' The linesman raises his flag. Daniel Mosquera (Verona) is adjudged offside.
83' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Maurizio Mariani blows for a foul.
82' A substitution has been made. Amin Sarr goes off and Daniel Mosquera (Verona) comes on.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jens Odgaard trots off the pitch and is replaced by Lewis Ferguson (Bologna).
79' Vincenzo Italiano decides to make a substitution. Emil Holm will be replaced by Nadir Zortea (Bologna).

78' Amin Sarr (Verona) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Federico Ravaglia anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going low into the middle of the target.
77' Paolo Zanetti prepares a substitution. Cheikh Niasse is replaced by Fallou Cham (Verona).
77' Verona will take a corner kick.
74' Juan Miranda (Bologna) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
74' The attendance for today's match is 17585.
71' The ball goes out of play and it will be a corner kick.
71' 2 - 3 Remo Freuler (Bologna) puts the ball past his own goalkeeper.
66' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nikola Moro (Bologna) replacing Tommaso Pobega.
65' Here's the change. Santiago Castro leaves the pitch and Ciro Immobile (Bologna) comes on as a substitute.

64' Amin Sarr (Verona) has a good chance to get on the scoresheet and fires the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
62' Gift Orban (Verona) is flagged for offside.
61' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) drills in an effort from the edge of the box that climbs rapidly and goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
61' Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
61' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bologna.

60' Emil Holm (Bologna) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. The referee points to the corner flag and Bologna will take a corner.
59' Maurizio Mariani shows a yellow card to Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) for his blatant foul.
57' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
54' A spell of possession for Bologna in an attempt to control the game.
53' Here is a change. Suat Serdar is going off and Paolo Zanetti gives the last tactical orders to Giovane (Verona).
53' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Al Musrati departs the field of play to be replaced by Roberto Gagliardini (Verona).
52' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Maurizio Mariani stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
50' Verona have been awarded a corner kick.
50' Santiago Castro (Bologna) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
48' Some patient build-up play from Verona as they look to unlock the defence.
46' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Unai Nunez leaves the pitch and Tobias Slotsager (Verona) comes on.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' A snap shot by Gift Orban (Verona) from the edge of the area flies towards the right side of the goal, but Federico Ravaglia produces a good save to thwart him.
44' 1 - 3 Santiago Castro (Bologna) scores an absolute screamer from outside the penalty area, with the ball flying into the top left corner!
42' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Martin Vitik (Bologna) was quite harsh and Maurizio Mariani didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
41' The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick. Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety.
40' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
39' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) misses a sitter from inside the six-yard box after striking the ball narrowly wide of the goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
37' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
35' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) steps up to send the ball in.
32' The ball is out of play. Bologna will have a chance to score from a corner.
31' Bologna are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
29' 1 - 2 Jens Odgaard (Bologna) picks up the ball on the edge of the penalty box and produces a moment of magic with a brilliant shot that goes into the left side of the goal!
27' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.

25' Gift Orban (Verona) blows a chance to score! He pinged a fine header from deep inside the box towards the net, but his aim was off and it flew narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.

24' Santiago Castro (Bologna) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Lorenzo Montipo tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
24' Bologna keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.

21' 1 - 1 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the top left corner of the net.
21' Nicolas Valentini (Verona) is penalised for holding. Maurizio Mariani signals a set piece. Bologna have a free kick from a promising distance.
19' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bologna.
17' Amin Sarr (Verona) is adjudged offside.

13' 1 - 0 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Gift Orban (Verona) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the right side of the net.
12' Unai Nunez (Verona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Maurizio Mariani had an easy-decision to make.
12' Unai Nunez (Verona) was too forceful with his tackle and Maurizio Mariani interrupted the game to signal a free kick.

11' Antoine Bernede (Verona) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
8' Santiago Castro (Bologna) climbs high to connect with a cross on the edge of the box, but his header is off-target. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
7' Some neat passing and movement from Bologna as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
5' Gift Orban (Verona) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
3' Martin Vitik (Bologna) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
2' Bologna are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
